annotation.evidence_span: MUST accept all three HTTP-date formats
annotation.interpretation_a: The recipient must be able to parse all three formats without error, even if it doesn't *use* the parsed values.
annotation.interpretation_b: The recipient must successfully parse all three formats and be able to use the resulting date/time values in subsequent processing.
annotation.justification: The verb 'accept' is vague. Does it only require parsing without error, or does it require the recipient to be able to *use* the parsed date/time value? Both interpretations are reasonable, and the lack of a clarifying constraint makes the requirement ambiguous.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether 'accept' means 'parse without error' or 'parse and be able to use the resulting value'. A missing constraint on whether successful parsing implies successful use creates ambiguity.
